item.title: IDF uncovers Hezbollah weapons stash inside hospital in Lebanon
item.summary: Israel Defense Forces uncovered a weapons stash used by Hezbollah terrorists inside a hospital in Lebanon this weekend.

item.title: Outrage builds over illegal immigrant ‘invasion’ after suspect allegedly executes teen who begged for life
item.summary: The killing of Missouri teen Miles Young, who allegedly begged for his life during a deadly ambush, sparks Republican outrage over immigration policies.

item.title: The AI revolution threatens office jobs, but revives demand for skilled trades
item.summary: AI threatens white-collar jobs more than blue-collar trades, highlighting an urgent need to realign education with workforce demands in America.

item.title: Boatyard employee found 'exhausted' missing American's husband when he washed ashore after night adrift
item.summary: The employee described Brian Hooker as exhausted when he landed on a rocky beach in Marsh Harbour, Bahamas, seeking help after he said his wife fell overboard from the couple's dinghy.

item.title: Trump gets Dana White to add fight to UFC White House card after personal ask
item.summary: President Donald Trump asked Dana White to add Derrick Lewis to the UFC Freedom 250 White House event, leading to a new bout against Josh Hokit.

item.title: Ex-Biden staffer claims accidental shot killed girlfriend as dad blasts toxic, abusive relationship: report
item.summary: The father of Samantha Emge, allegedly killed by ex-Biden staffer boyfriend Nation Wood, claims red flags and abuse in their relationship.

item.title: Appeals court says federal judge must reconsider blocking WH ballroom, weigh national security concerns
item.summary: A three-judge appeals panel ruled Trump's $400 million White House ballroom construction can proceed until Friday as security concerns are reviewed.

item.title: Hungarians vote in record numbers as Trump-ally Viktor Orbán faces biggest electoral threat since 2010
item.summary: Hungarians vote in pivotal election pitting PM Viktor Orbán against rival Peter Magyar. Vice President JD Vance visited Hungary last week where he met with the prime minister.

item.title: NASA chief declares America 'absolutely back' in space race, says US will beat China to the moon
item.summary: NASA says America is "absolutely back" in the space race, rushing to beat China to the moon and build a lunar base under Trump-era Artemis program.

item.title: Catholic nuns caring for dying patients fight New York trans rule, face jail time
item.summary: Catholic nuns sue New York over a law requiring nursing homes to follow gender identity rules, saying it forces them to choose faith or mission.
